name: StreamClip Pro — Live Stream Replay Clipper
description: Instant-replay clipping for Twitch, Kick, YouTube and any live stream. Keep a rolling buffer of every stream you watch and save the best moments in one click — at full quality, only when you ask.

clip-active-tab.description: Clip the current tab (or all monitored tabs if the current tab isn't monitored)

clip-all-tabs.description: Clip every monitored stream at once

toggle-monitor.description: Start or stop monitoring the current tab
